## Overview

Humans are the most populous of the common races of Kythoria. They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~100 years). Their adaptability has made them central to the Last Stand's survival and the reconquering effort.

---

## Origins

Like all mortal races, Humans were created by the **Originals** (A, B, C). The gods' claim that **Aloria** created the Humans is a calculated deception.

**Note:** Humans were also the subject of later Crimson Covenant experiments (demonic tissue grafts) which produced the first **Tieflings** ~500-600 years ago. See `tieflings.md`.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Aloria** | Light & Life | Humans |

Aloria is the goddess of light and life. Her church, the **Order of the Dawn**, is the most politically powerful religious institution -- its priests come closest to understanding the hidden truth (see `culture_and_society.md` secrets). Her claim over the most populous race grants her church enormous influence.

---

## Society & Culture

Human culture follows standard Fifth Edition norms. Humans are found everywhere across Kythoria -- in the three capitals, frontier settlements, and recovered territories. Their adaptability and ambition drive much of the reconquering effort.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Human traits (versatile ability score increases, extra skill/language). No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.

---

## Social Standing

Humans face no blame related to the divine conspiracy. Their claimed god (Aloria) is one of the seven publicly blameless gods. Humans hold significant political power through the Church of Light and Life and the governance of the three capitals.

---

## Notable Individuals

- **Aegon** -- Human paladin of Aurelius, "The Rogue Paragon," bearer of visions from B's consciousness (see `aegon.md`).
- **Bardolemeu Romeo** -- Human bard from a wealthy theater-owning family (see `bardolemeu_romeo.md`).
- **Sanzo** -- Human monk (see `sanzo.md`).
- **Paul** -- Human priest of the Order of the Protectors, Aegon's father figure, killed by Order of the Scales agents (see `paul.md`).
